environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. The Flask app is served via gunicorn with 4 workers, exposed on port 8080. The SQLite database is initialized with seed data including admin accounts. No input sanitization middleware is present.
